title: Design System: Mesh Health Check field utility

code.purpose: Exact code to send from MeshCore; not a display headline.

count.purpose: Observed / expected targets, using tabular numerals.

shadows.name: flat
shadows.purpose: App surfaces use separators and neutral layers.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Button background and border state changes only.

components.name: Copy code
components.description: Primary transmit action; fixed-radius, no lift or glow.
components.css: .ds-copy { min-height:44px; padding:9px 12px; border:1px solid #245eb0; border-radius:4px; background:#245eb0; color:#fff; font:600 .875rem/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms ease,border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-copy:hover { background:#1c4f99; border-color:#1c4f99; } .ds-copy:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #8cbcff; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-copy:active { background:#272c32; color:#f1f2f3; } .ds-copy:disabled { opacity:.55; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: New Code, Share and header utilities; dark preview.
components.css: .ds-dark { background:#202429; padding:8px; } .ds-secondary { min-height:44px; padding:9px 12px; border:1px solid #59616c; border-radius:4px; background:transparent; color:#f1f2f3; font:.875rem/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms ease,border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-secondary:hover { background:#272c32; border-color:#8cbcff; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #8cbcff; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-secondary:active { background:#272c32; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity:.55; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Reception meter
components.description: Native count-based meter; this preview is unmeasured, not a live result.
components.html:
Observers reached

0 / 2 Awaiting message

Score --
components.css: .ds-reception { background:#202429; color:#b0b7c0; padding:16px; font:.875rem/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-reception p { margin:6px 0 12px; } .ds-reception strong { color:#f1f2f3; font:600 2rem/1.3 ui-monospace,monospace; margin-right:12px; } .ds-meter { appearance:none; width:100%; height:10px; display:block; border:0; border-radius:2px; background:#393f46; color:#8cbcff; } .ds-meter::-webkit-progress-bar { background:#393f46; border-radius:2px; } .ds-meter::-webkit-progress-value { background:#8cbcff; } .ds-meter::-moz-progress-bar { background:#8cbcff; }

components.name: Pending target row
components.description: Neutral named state with no repeated status pill; illustrative row.
components.css: .ds-target { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; min-height:52px; padding:8px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #393f46; background:#202429; color:#b0b7c0; font:.8125rem/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-target strong { display:block; font-size:.875rem; color:#f1f2f3; } .ds-target small { font:.75rem/1.45 ui-monospace,monospace; }

components.name: Observer checkbox row
components.description: Native checkbox plus identity; illustrative row, not live telemetry.
components.css: .ds-observer { display:grid; grid-template-columns:20px minmax(0,1fr); align-items:center; gap:10px; min-height:56px; padding:8px; background:#272c32; border-bottom:1px solid #393f46; color:#f1f2f3; font:.875rem/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-observer input { width:18px; height:18px; margin:0; accent-color:#8cbcff; } .ds-observer input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #8cbcff; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-observer strong { display:block; } .ds-observer small { color:#b0b7c0; font:.75rem/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace; } .ds-observer:hover { background:#202429; }

narrative.overview: The app is a practical transmit-and-check workspace. Controls and real reception evidence carry the page; branding stays recognizable without taking over the first viewport. Phone use in changing ambient light requires both a dark and a light theme, not an assumed dark-only radio aesthetic.
keyCharacteristics: Compact configured identity, prominent transmit code and channel.
Count-first reception, with score and diagnostics secondary.
Flat surfaces, subtle separators and compact observer rows.
Restrained blue for actions, selection and received state.
dos: Do keep configured branding and channel wording intact.
Do distinguish pending reception from measured zero or unseen targets.
Do keep score-selection guidance visible and conditional on available controls.
Do verify dark/light layouts, keyboard focus and no horizontal overflow.
donts: Don't change scoring, observer selection or location privacy through layout work.
Don't add gradients, glow, giant rounded tiles or monospace UI labels.
Don't apply these app-only overrides to shared-result or access pages.
